Purpose: Prevents scalar/object confusion when one row is returned.
Ensures grouping evidence is based on a normalized list.
Blank Markdown lines are valid content and must not crash a writer.

RequiredPattern: Every [pscustomobject] row has identical property names; missing values become empty strings.
Purpose: Prevents CSV/report drift and missing-property evidence gaps.
Prevents count-property failure on generated outputs.

BadPattern: Function receives scalar where list is expected
RequiredPattern: Declare [string[]] or [object[]] explicitly and call with @($Value)
Purpose: Prevents argument type mismatch in generated helper functions.

RequiredPattern: If blocker_count or issue_count > 0, final_verdict must be BLOCKED or REVIEW_REQUIRED.

BadPattern: Generated rollup accepted without source count, unique count, diff sets, duplicate groups, receipt, static gate, dry-run gate
RequiredPattern: Rollup authority requires source counts, unique counts, diff sets, duplicate groups, hash receipt, static contract gate, and dry-run fixture gate.
Purpose: Stops generated rollups from becoming active authority without proof.
